rows.q: What is Zyngram?
rows.answer:
Zyngram's physical, real-world franchise structure has five levels, from smallest to largest: Point, Center, Hub, Command, and Headquarters (HQ).

Separate from the physical franchise hierarchy, Zyngram also tracks a digital hierarchy for mapping and analytics purposes: Node, Zone, Territory, Region, and Nation, from smallest to largest.

Zyngram is a hyperlocal franchise-based service platform. It connects customers to everyday services such as mobile recharge, utility bill payments, and local deliveries through a franchise network spread across India.

Zyngram's physical, real-world franchise structure has five levels, from smallest to largest: Point, Center, Hub, Command, and Headquarters (HQ).

A Point is the smallest unit, typically covering a single neighborhood. Several Points report to one Center, which usually covers a town or a city area. Several Centers report to one Hub, which covers a district-level area. Several Hubs report to one Command, which covers a state-level area. All Commands report to Zyngram HQ, which sets policy for the entire network.

rows.q: What is the digital mapping hierarchy?
rows.answer:
Separate from the physical franchise hierarchy, Zyngram also tracks a digital hierarchy for mapping and analytics purposes: Node, Zone, Territory, Region, and Nation, from smallest to largest.

A customer's GPS location is mapped internally to a Node, which rolls up into a Zone, then a Territory, then a Region, and finally the Nation level. This digital hierarchy is used for geo-mapping and reporting, and is kept separate from the Point/Center/Hub/Command ownership hierarchy so that analytics changes never affect who owns a franchise.

rows.q: How does mobile recharge work?
rows.answer: Mobile Recharge was Zyngram's first live service. A customer enters their mobile number and recharge amount, the order is validated, and once confirmed, the recharge is processed and the order status moves to SUCCESS.

rows.q: What happens if a customer confirms the same recharge order twice?
rows.answer:
If a recharge order fails after the amount is deducted, Zyngram automatically reverses the payment to your original payment method within 2 to 5 business days.

Mobile Recharge orders are protected against duplicate confirmation: if a customer tries to confirm the same order twice, the second attempt is rejected and logged, so the customer cannot be charged twice for one recharge.

rows.q: Which utility bills can be paid through Zyngram?
rows.answer: Utility Bill Payment lets customers pay electricity, water, and gas bills through the Zyngram app. The customer enters their consumer number, the current bill amount is fetched, and payment is confirmed the same way as a recharge order, through a validate-then-confirm flow.

rows.q: What is the Local Delivery service?
rows.answer: Local Delivery is a hyperlocal delivery service where a nearby franchise Point fulfills small delivery requests - groceries, documents, or small parcels - within its own neighborhood coverage area, usually within a few kilometers.

rows.q: How do I apply for a franchise?
rows.answer: Submit a franchise application through the Zyngram app or website, specifying the level (Point, Center, Hub, or Command) and area you want. An admin reviews and approves or rejects the application.

rows.q: How is commission calculated across the franchise hierarchy?
rows.answer: A calculated commission moves through a lifecycle: CALCULATED, then PENDING, then ELIGIBLE, and finally SETTLED. Only an admin can settle a commission, moving its value into the franchise owner's wallet.

rows.q: What happens to commission if a franchise level has no owner?
rows.answer: If a level in the hierarchy currently has no owner assigned, that level's commission is simply skipped - it is never paid to a different franchise or held pending, and this is logged for transparency.

rows.q: What are the stages of the commission lifecycle?
rows.answer:
A calculated commission moves through a lifecycle: CALCULATED, then PENDING, then ELIGIBLE, and finally SETTLED. Only an admin can settle a commission, moving its value into the franchise owner's wallet.

When a customer completes an order, Zyngram calculates commission for every level of the franchise hierarchy the order is attributed to: Point, Center, Hub, and Command can each earn a percentage of the order amount, based on the commission rule active for that service at the time of the order.

rows.q: How is the franchise wallet balance derived?
rows.answer: A franchise owner's wallet balance is never stored as a single stale number - it is always derived fresh from the ledger of settled commission entries, so the balance can never silently drift out of sync with the actual payment history.
